title: NYC Asian Professionals & Entrepreneurs Networking Night
description: A curated networking night connecting Asian professionals, entrepreneurs, creatives, founders, and community leaders in NYC
long_description:
A curated networking night connecting Asian professionals, entrepreneurs, creatives, founders, and community leaders in NYC

About this Event

This event brings together entrepreneurs, founders, creatives, investors, professionals, community leaders, and ambitious individuals from all Asian backgrounds to build genuine connections, exchange ideas, and discover new opportunities.

Whether you're growing a business, advancing your career, expanding your network, or simply looking to connect with like-minded professionals, this gathering offers a welcoming and engaging environment to meet people beyond your usual circles.

Who Should Attend?

• Entrepreneurs & Startup Founders

• Business Professionals

• Investors & Advisors

• Creatives & Artists

• Marketing & Media Professionals

• Tech Professionals

• Community Builders

• Students & Emerging Leaders

What to Expect

✨ Curated networking and introductions

✨ Meaningful conversations beyond small talk

✨ Opportunities for collaboration and business growth

✨ A diverse and welcoming Asian professional community

✨ Great venue, drinks, and positive energy

A Community for All Asian Backgrounds

We welcome professionals and entrepreneurs from all Asian backgrounds, including East Asian, Southeast Asian, South Asian, Central Asian, Pacific Islander, and mixed-heritage communities.

Whether your roots are Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Taiwanese, Vietnamese, Filipino, Indian, Pakistani, Bangladeshi, Thai, Indonesian, Malaysian, Singaporean, Nepali, Sri Lankan, Mongolian, or elsewhere across Asia, this event is designed to celebrate the diversity and strength of our community.

Why Attend?

Many of the strongest business partnerships, friendships, collaborations, and opportunities begin with a simple conversation.

Come meet inspiring people, expand your network, and become part of a growing community of Asian professionals in New York City.
